Verses.Text: For God who said, Let light shine out of darkness, has shone in our hearts to bring to light the knowledge of the glory of God on the face of [Jesus] Christ.
Therefore, we are not discouraged; rather, although our outer self is wasting away, our inner self is being renewed day by day.
So whoever is in Christ is a new creation: the old things have passed away; behold, new things have come.
So we are ambassadors for Christ, as if God were appealing through us.
Each must do as already determined, without sadness or compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
My grace is sufficient for you, for power is made perfect in weakness.
